title: Structural properties of transcendental polynomial localization
statement: Let $D$ and $S$ be commutative local Artinian rings (each has a unique maximal ideal and every descending chain of ideals stabilizes), let $g:D\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism, and let $x\in S$. Regard $K=S/\mathfrak m_S$ as a field extension of $F=D/\mathfrak m_D$ using the residue-field embedding induced by $g$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Suppose $\operatorname{res}_S(x)$ is transcendental over $F$, meaning no nonzero polynomial over $F$ vanishes there [def-weil-algebraic-element]. Set $\theta:D[t]\to S$, $t\mapsto x$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and $P=\theta^{-1}(\mathfrak m_S)$. Let $T_0=D[t]_P$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $T$ be its canonical universe lift to $\mathrm{Type}(\max(u,v,z))$ if $D:\mathrm{Type}(u)$ and $S:\mathrm{Type}(v)$. Then $T$ is local Artinian and $D\to T$ is local and essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map].

proof.text: Reduce polynomial evaluation using the residue maps. Ring-hom extensionality identifies aeval(residue x) after coefficient reduction with residue after evaluation. Transcendence forces a reduced polynomial to be zero exactly when its evaluation vanishes. Ideal.mem_map_C_iff and coefficient extensionality therefore identify P with map C (maximalIdeal D). No flatness or evaluation injectivity is required.

D is Noetherian by instIsNoetherianRingOfIsArtinianRing, Polynomial D by Polynomial.isNoetherianRing, and its localization by the localization Noetherian instance. Apply isArtinianRing_iff_isNilpotent_maximalIdeal to D to obtain a nilpotence exponent. Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal identifies the maximal ideal of L. Map the equality of coefficient ideals, then use Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_pow and Ideal.map_bot to transport that exponent. The reverse direction of the same Mathlib criterion proves L is Artinian, without the quotient-Artinian lemma.

For d in maximalIdeal D, the constant polynomial C d belongs to P by coefficientwise membership. IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff implies its image belongs to maximalIdeal L. local_hom_TFAE gives locality of D to L. ULift.ringEquiv transports locality and Artinianity; mapping a unit down reflects units for the lifted algebra map.

Polynomial D is formally smooth and finitely presented, hence smooth. Let Q be its explicit ULift, with algebra equivalence e, and let M be the image of P.primeCompl under e. Smooth.of_equiv makes Q smooth. Compose ULift.algEquiv with IsLocalization.algEquivOfAlgEquiv to give the required algebra equivalence from ULift L to Localization M. These constructed data witness EssentiallySmooth.

mathlib_searches.query: Localization of a polynomial ring over a local Artinian ring at a transcendental residue prime is Artinian and evaluation into a flat local Artinian algebra is flat

lean.statement:
theorem localization_artinian_transcendental_properties
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    [Algebra D S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap D S)]
    (hflat : (algebraMap D S).Flat) (x : S)
    (hx : Transcendental (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D) (IsLocalRing.residue S x)) :
    let P : Ideal (Polynomial D) :=
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap D S) x)
    letI : P.IsPrime := inferInstance
    let T := ULift.{max u v z} (Localization.AtPrime P)
    IsLocalRing T ∧ IsArtinianRing T ∧ IsLocalHom (algebraMap D T) ∧
      EssentiallySmooth D T
